posts.hook: Anthropic's next product doesn't wait for you to open it
posts.caption: anthropic previews claude duet, a background agent that briefs you and works on its own virtual machine, meta is ordered to pay a $25b penalty in new mexico, aws says php exploitation began four days before disclosure. full digest at sift.yasint.dev (link in bio)

slides.title: Claude Duet is an agent that works in the background and ==pings you only when needed==
slides.desc: It runs on its own virtual machine and asks approval before sending, paying or deleting.

slides.title: PHP2Shell exploitation began ==four days before== public disclosure, AWS analysts say
slides.desc: Patching on disclosure day was already late for some servers, so check older logs.

slides.title: GitLab patches a critical flaw that lets attackers run code without logging in
slides.desc: It affects every release since 2014, so self-hosted instances should update today.

slides.title: Meta is ordered to pay a $25B penalty over privacy deception in New Mexico
slides.desc: A far larger sum than a typical privacy fine; any appeal outcome is not yet known.

slides.title: Railway says customer environment variables may have been accessed
slides.desc: Those hold keys and passwords, so affected customers should rotate them.

terms.gloss: settings where apps keep secrets like api keys and passwords

slides.title: Tesla's profit fell 43% and unsupervised driving slips to 2027
slides.desc: Autonomy timing is again the swing factor for a shrinking-margin car business.

terms.gloss: self-driving with no human watching the road
